_comment: All quotes derive from these drivers + lane distance. Edit here, never hardcode a lane price.

sourcing._comment: Owners near the pickup absorb most of a short empty run (the truck would otherwise sit idle); deadheadChargedShare is the part they price in.

_fixedCostComment: EMI, insurance, tyres, permit and maintenance per loaded km. A 32 ft MXL costing ₹40-45 lakh pays about ₹11/km in EMI alone at 8,000 km a month, so ₹16/km all-in; other types scaled the same way (review, 29 Oct).

22 ft.basis: FR8 20/22/24 ft container listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

24 ft SXL.basis: between FR8 22 ft and 32 ft SXL; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

32 ft SXL.basis: FR8 32 ft SXL listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

32 ft MXL.basis: FR8 32 ft MXL listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

Taurus (10-tyre).basis: estimate below FR8 12/14-wheel listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

20 ft container.basis: FR8 20/22/24 ft container listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

12-wheeler.basis: FR8 12-wheel open truck listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

14-wheeler.basis: FR8 14-wheel open truck listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

Trailer 40 ft.basis: estimate above FR8 14-wheel listings; short-haul fixed charge lowered after an operator review (28 Oct)

_marketComment: Market full-truck price = fixedRs + perKm x distance, fitted to FR8 published lane rates (fr8.in, Mumbai to Vapi/Ankleshwar/Ahmedabad/Bhopal/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Chennai/Coimbatore, Oct 2026). Short trips cost more per km. Agreed rates on a lane (lane memory) are blended in as they come. Short-haul fixed charges lowered 28 Oct after an operator review found Bhiwandi-Surat MXL ~15-30% high; check against evidence/lane_quotes.csv once filled.
_truckComment: Typical body and load space (cubic feet) in the Indian market: 14-22 ft LCV/ICV come as open or closed bodies, SXL/MXL are closed containers, a Taurus is an open high-side truck. Owners confirm the body when they quote.
_tollComment: Per-km toll by axle class, from NHAI's base rates (2008 fee rules: 2-axle 2.20, 3-axle 2.40, 4-6 axle 3.45 per km) with the yearly revisions to 2026, about +90% with expressway stretches; expressways cost more. An estimate until per-plaza totals are summed.

seasons.name: Diwali week
seasons._comment: Drivers go home, so supply falls hardest this week. Surat's textile markets stay shut until Labh Pancham, so loads into Surat get no premium.

_seasonComment: Drivers go home for festivals and dispatch peaks at year-end and harvest: spot rates rise. Working estimates to tune with lane memory.
_dieselComment: Retail diesel, Mumbai, Oct 2026 (₹97.83). The console's diesel field overrides it; update it daily.
_minTripDaysComment: Loading and unloading waits make even a 250 km trip two calendar days of driver and helper pay.

shortHaulBand._comment: Short-haul FTL under 400 km is competitive: brokers typically mark up 5-8% or take a flat ₹1-2k. Longer lanes and special goods (hazardous, perishable) keep marginBand.

_maxOverMarketComment: The shipper is never quoted more than this % above the lane's market rate; above it the broker decides.
_returnLoadComment: No return-load adjustment: the chance of a return load was a guess per lane, so it no longer moves prices. Add it back from real data (booked return loads per lane).
